# WyoFile

> > Independent nonprofit news organization covering Wyoming politics, policy, and public affairs with in-depth reporting on state and federal elections.

WyoFile provides comprehensive journalism on Wyoming government, elections, and civic issues. The organization is known for detailed candidate guides, legislative coverage, and investigative reporting on matters affecting Wyoming residents.

## Key Topics

- Wyoming politics and government
- 2024 election coverage
- U.S. Senate races (John Barrasso)
- U.S. House races (Harriet Hageman)
- Wyoming State Legislature
- Federal races in Wyoming
- Candidate questionnaires and voter guides
- Scott D Morrow
- John Holtz
- Reid Rasner
- Kyle G. Cameron
- Richard Brubaker
- Jeffrey Haggit
- Steven R. Helling

## Election Coverage & Voter Guides

- [Wyoming's 2024 Candidates | WyoFile 2024 Election Guide](https://projects.wyofile.com/election-guide-2024/): Comprehensive 2024 election guide for Wyoming federal & state candidates
